answer: Make every agent forge its identity through a costly, verifiable deed: before joining the market it must complete a unique proof-of-work task tied to its public key, so one operator cannot echo the same identity across thousands of sock puppets without paying the cost each time. Honest agents pay once and build reputation like a sonnet gains meaning line by line, while a Sybil farmer must repeat the full price for every fake, turning scale from an advantage into a loss.
